user.title: Connect an EZVIZ camera
user.description: Browse SD-card recordings and download each selected clip on demand. Choose the EZVIZ API region for your account. Serial number accepts either the full sticker serial or the short API serial. Important: turn off Video Encryption in the EZVIZ app for compatible SD-card playback.

data.serial: Camera serial number (full sticker serial or short API serial)

mfa.title: Verify your EZVIZ account
mfa.description: Enter the one-time code sent by EZVIZ to {username}.

region.title: Enter a custom EZVIZ API region
region.description: Enter only the API hostname, for example apiisgp.ezvizlife.com. Do not include https:// or a path.

error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected by EZVIZ.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the EZVIZ service.
error.mfa_required: The verification code was rejected. Try again.
error.unknown: Could not authenticate. Check the region host and Home Assistant logs.

configure_media.title: Configure Media
configure_media.description: Choose date and recording order. Media Sync is Off by default. When enabled, the integration checks for new recordings every 15 minutes and downloads recordings in the selected rolling window. Cached videos and thumbnails are stored in .storage/ezviz_sd_card_recordings/<entry_id> by default. Set a Cold storage path outside your config (for example /media/ezviz_sd_card_recordings/front_camera) to avoid bloating backups.

data.order_days: Order of days in Media Browser
data.order_recordings: Order of recordings in Media Browser

delete_cache.title: Delete all cache and recording
delete_cache.description: Delete all locally cached videos and thumbnails for this camera. Recordings on the physical camera SD card are not deleted. This action cannot be undone.

data.confirm: I understand: delete all cached videos and thumbnails

sync_window.title: Media Sync settings
sync_window.description: Choose automatic sync to keep the latest 24 hours up to date, or a custom rolling window of 1–168 hours. Synchronization runs every 15 minutes. Cold storage path is optional; leave it empty to use the default private cache.

sync_hours.title: Custom synchronization window
sync_hours.description: Enter the number of recent hours to keep cached. New recordings in this rolling window are picked up automatically during the 15-minute checks. Maximum: 168 hours (7 days).

data.sync_hours: Number of hours to keep synchronized

error.path_in_use: This cold storage path is already assigned to another camera.
error.invalid_hours: Enter a number from 1 to 168 hours.
